package.name: moveit_teleop_devices
package.description:
Teleoperation input device drivers. Every driver here normalizes some physical device into moveit_teleop_msgs and nothing more.
This package depends on moveit_teleop_msgs ONLY. It must never gain a dependency on moveit_teleop_core, MoveIt, or a robot description: that one-way dependency is what makes the device layer a real seam rather than a decoration.
